results.strFilename: Twenty20 International Series 2026-10-17 India Cricket vs West Indies Cricket
results.strResult: 5th T20I (series decider), M. Chinnaswamy Stadium, Bengaluru - ABANDONED due to rain. Reduced to 9 overs/side; West Indies won toss, chose to field. India reached 118/5 in 7.4 overs (Ishan Kishan 30 off 10) before rain returned; match officially abandoned with no result, West Indies innings never started. With no reserve day, the 5-match series finished tied 2-2. Source: outlookindia.com
